context: After the party frees the hostages from the Iron Throne and exits the submersible, the player and rescued families are safe for the moment. Duke Ulder Ravengard has been recovered but is still dazed — his mind was recently compromised and he’s confused when he first appears. The Emperor’s protection has been extended to Ravengard, so he is now under imperial safeguard like the player. Wyll, who is Ravengard’s son, urges him to go to the camp to recover; Ravengard will remain in camp and the two will have a private conversation there later.
